summary: NatWest Group plc (NWG) filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market share repurchases under an existing buyback program. Over the past week, it bought ~2.38M ordinary shares from UBS AG at prices ranging from 652.8 to 672 GBp, with volume-weighted average prices per venue between ~659 and ~664 GBp. Board authorized this buyback on 16 Feb 2026. Shares will be canceled, reducing outstanding count. Post-settlement, NWG holds 178.8M treasury shares and ~7.97B shares outstanding. This is a routine capital return execution, not a tender offer or special situation; no premium, advisor, or unusual terms. Watch for ongoing cancellation impact on EPS.
